title: Course Categories
subtitle: Categories and tags — every course needs a category before it can be created
slugHint: Used in the catalog page address. Leave it blank — it is built from the name.
descriptionPlaceholder: Optional, shown on the catalog page
empty: No categories yet — courses cannot be created until you add at least one.
nameRequired: The category name is required and must be at least 2 characters.
inUseHint: Still used by courses — deactivate it instead.
hint: A category still used by courses cannot be deleted. Deactivate it to take it off the catalog without touching those courses.
tagSubtitle: Extra labels for filtering courses. Optional — courses can be created without any tag.
tagNameRequired: The tag name is required and must be at least 2 characters.
